goblin_scout.label: Goblin Scout
goblin_scout.description: A wiry goblin with quick hands and a rusty blade. It eyes you hungrily.

goblin_chief.label: Goblin Chief
goblin_chief.description: A massive goblin in a crown of finger bones. Three gold teeth glint as he bellows.

skeleton.label: Skeleton Warrior
skeleton.description: A rattling skeleton in rusted armor, moving with grim and purposeful silence.

dark_cultist.label: Dark Cultist
dark_cultist.description: A robed figure with solid black eyes. Dark energy crackles at his fingertips.

stone_golem.label: Stone Golem
stone_golem.description: An ancient stone guardian, eyes glowing red. Every step shakes the floor.

elder_dragon.label: Elder Dragon
elder_dragon.description: Midnight-black scales coiled atop a mountain of gold and bones. Each breath scorches the air. This is what the dungeon was built to protect.
